stories.title: Create Answer Key Completeness Validator for All Knowledge Assessments
stories.description: Validate that every knowledge assessment (KA) document has complete, well-formatted answer keys with scoring guidance for all assessment items. Scans KA/KT markdown files and ensures answer schemes are present with marking rubrics and source references.
acceptanceCriteria: Validator script reads all */KA.md and */KT.md files and checks 100% of assessment items have model answers
Each answer includes point allocation, marking guidance (for essays), and KP section reference—flags missing details
Report output lists: subject/CU, total items, items with answers, coverage %, and list of incomplete items with file:line_number

Test command: uv run pytest _tools/test_answer_key_validator.py::test_answer_key_coverage_100_percent -v
Input: finds all KA.md/KT.md via glob pattern bev-diagnostic-rectification/C*/KA.md, aesthetic-services/C*/KA.md, it-computer-system/L*/KA.md
stories._rejection_reason: too_simple: only 1 measurable ACs -- specify test commands, file paths, or numeric thresholds

stories.title: Create PM Lesson Plan Completeness Auditor
stories.description: Validate all Lesson Plans (PM-teori.md and PM-amali.md) contain required sections with sufficient detail per Buku Panduan WIM 2020 guidelines. Enforces 4-phase structure and mandatory section headers.
acceptanceCriteria: Auditor scans all PM-teori.md and PM-amali.md files; checks for TAJUK, TUJUAN (2-3 learning outcomes), PENERANGAN header, and 4 phases: Persediaan, Pengenalan, Penyajian, Kesimpulan
Each phase must include: Tempoh (duration in minutes), Kaedah Pengajaran, Sumber Pembelajaran, and Penilaian

stories.title: Build Practical Procedure Safety Checkpoint Intensity Classifier

stories.title: Assessment Question Time-Box Validator
stories.description: Analyze and validate that assessment questions have realistic time estimates matching question type, complexity level, and cognitive domain. Flags unrealistic time allocations and ensures total exam duration fits allocated time slots.
acceptanceCriteria: Validator reads all KA.md/KT.md files and extracts question type (MCQ, essay, calculation, short answer) and Bloom's level (remember/understand/apply/analyze/evaluate/create)

stories.title: Aesthetic Services Knowledge Assessment Item Analysis Report Generator
stories.description: Generate item analysis reports for Aesthetic knowledge assessments showing facility index, discrimination index, distractor effectiveness, and identifying problematic items needing revision or retirement.
acceptanceCriteria: Analysis tool computes per-question: Facility Index (% of students who answered correctly; target 0.4-0.8), Discrimination Index (difficulty difference between high/low performers; target >0.2), Option Analysis (% choosing each distractor)
Identifies problematic items: facility <0.2 (too hard) or >0.9 (too easy), discrimination <0.2 (not differentiating), ineffective distractors (chosen <5%)
Report: Question ID, Item Type, Facility Index, Discrimination Index, Distractor Analysis, Recommendation (Revise/Retire/Keep), Priority for Revision
technicalNotes: File to create: aesthetic-services/tools/item_analysis_generator.py (functions: calculate_facility_index, calculate_discrimination_index, analyze_distractors, generate_item_analysis_report)
